transcript.content:
A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: Let me compare per-service span behavior between the normal and abnormal periods.

input.query: SELECT 'normal' p, service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,2), sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1
SELECT 'normal' p, service_name, level, count(*) n FROM normal_logs GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', service_name, level, count(*) FROM abnormal_logs GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1

SELECT p.service_name psvc, p.span_name pname, c.service_name csvc, c.span_name cname, c.attr_span_kind ck, count(*) n, round(avg(p.duration)/1e6,1) pms, round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,1) cms, sum(CASE WHEN c.attr_http_response_status_code>=400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) c4xx FROM abnormal_traces c JOIN abnormal_traces p ON c.parent_span_id=p.span_id AND c.trace_id=p.trace_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT p.service_name psvc, p.span_name pname, c.service_name csvc, c.span_name cname, c.attr_span_kind ck, count(*) n, round(avg(p.duration)/1e6,1) pms, round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,1) cms FROM normal_traces c JOIN normal_traces p ON c.parent_span_id=p.span_id AND c.trace_id=p.trace_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT metric, attr_source, attr_destination, count(*) n, round(avg(value),2) avgv, round(max(value),2) maxv FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE metric LIKE 'hubble%' OR attr_source IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3 LIMIT 200
SELECT metric, service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, count(*) n, round(avg(value),3) avgv, round(max(value),3) maxv FROM abnormal_metrics GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3
